description: A thirty-two step trigger sequencer: you switch steps on in the grid, and each clock pulse that lands on a step which is on produces a gate

params.text: Sets how many steps the sequence runs before it returns to the first, 1 to 32

inputs.text: A rising crossing of 0.5V here advances the sequence by one step
A rising crossing of 0.5V here returns the sequence to its first step

outputs.text: 10V for as long as the clock stays high on a step that is switched on, and 0V otherwise

notes: the module produces nothing until you switch steps on: click a square in the grid to toggle it, and drag across squares to paint a run of them to the same state
the grid shows sixteen of the thirty-two steps at once; the narrow strip under the grid switches between the two halves, and it only responds to a click when Follow active step is unchecked
the step squares are drawn as one display rather than as separate controls, so no individual step can be clicked for help of its own
bypassing the module passes CLK straight through to GATE
menu: Follow active step — checked, the grid jumps to whichever half holds the playing step; unchecked, the strip under the grid chooses the half by hand

inputs.0:
high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
